title: Decision-Making Frameworks: ADRs & Trade-Off Matrices — D4
purpose: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
routing_rationale: Architectural choices must never rely on intuition; multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) transparently weights trade-offs and binds engineering teams to documented rationales.

nodes.label: Weighted Evaluation Model
nodes.detail: Defines quantitative scoring rubric across total cost of ownership, SLA, and developer velocity.

nodes.label: Option A: Compute Engine MIGs
nodes.detail: Score: 7.2/10. Requires manual OS patching, golden images, and custom auto-healing scripts.

nodes.label: Option B: GKE Autopilot
nodes.detail: Score: 8.9/10. Managed Kubernetes control plane, per-pod billing, native horizontal pod autoscaling.

nodes.label: Option C: Cloud Run
nodes.detail: Score: 9.4/10. Best fit for stateless HTTP APIs; fastest development velocity, zero idle server cost.

nodes.label: ADR-019: Cloud Run Selection
nodes.detail: Documents Context, Decision, Consequences, and rejected alternatives for enterprise audit.

steps.title: Scoring Matrix Evaluation
steps.action: Candidates scored against standardized criteria (pricing, SLA, operational burden).
steps.why_traversal: Grounds technology selection in objective data rather than vendor hype or developer bias.

steps.title: ADR Publication
steps.action: Winner recorded in Git repository under docs/adr/0019-compute-selection.md.
steps.why_traversal: Creates permanent context for future engineers, preventing re-debating settled choices.

scenarios.label: Hidden Operational Complexity Trap
scenarios.root_cause: Team selected Compute Engine purely on low raw VM pricing, ignoring $15k/mo engineer maintenance overhead.
scenarios.diverted_path: Operations team overwhelmed by kernel CVE patching and manual failovers.
scenarios.recovery: Incorporate total operational burden and fully burdened engineering hours into scoring rubric.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
